controls.title: Versioned metadata admission
controls.frozen_full_criterion: Identify the version/namespace distinction and require explicit compatibility validation or a truthful unsupported result; no implicit legacy reinterpretation.
controls.reason: Full: version/namespace recognition is connected to explicit admission/validation and truthful legacy rejection. Model/caller differences and hierarchy consistency are stated; storage presence is not accepted as OME conformance. Malformed/mixed-version and name fixtures are proposed, with compatibility policy kept explicit.
controls.limit: No runtime admission test. Temporary dual-storage migration is distinguished from arbitrary inconsistent OME versions.

controls.title: Axis-to-array identity
controls.frozen_full_criterion: Tie navigation/slicing to validated axis identity, distinguishing absent dimensions from length-one dimensions; reject mismatches without inventing sliders or coordinates.

participant_evidence.match: Axis names are arbitrary and unique
Exact rank equality is not a Read requirement

controls.reason: Half: axes/rank/name checks and correct conventional lower-rank broadcasting are materially developed. The text does not close the promised navigator/slicer behavior for absent versus length-one dimensions, including a discriminating UI/slicing acceptance check that avoids invented controls or coordinates. Backend singleton padding alone is not that product contract.
controls.limit: No fixed-5D falsehood remains. This is incomplete closure, not a claim valid low-rank input fails.

controls.title: Declared pyramid selection
controls.frozen_full_criterion: Use the declared level list and level-specific geometry; no lexicographic/numeric-folder ordering or fixed reduction assumption, with explicit missing-level handling.

participant_evidence.match: graceful fallback for one bad level

controls.reason: Full: declared group-relative level paths, highest-first order and per-level geometry are authoritative. Non-numeric paths and shape-derived/fixed reduction hazards are concrete. Referenced-path validation and bad-level fallback/diagnostics make missing-level handling explicit without fabricating a usable pyramid. These are discriminating proposed checks; exact private names/factors are unnecessary.
controls.limit: No runtime missing-level/pyramid rendering result; proposed fallback still needs implementation policy.

controls.title: Composed coordinate calibration
controls.frozen_full_criterion: Explain transform composition and unit/unknown-calibration treatment, with a concrete check that would expose reversed composition or omitted offsets.
controls.reason: Full: correct dataset-then-group composition, translations scaled at the proper stage, level-specific numerical scale/origin examples and unit/unknown-calibration treatment appear in participant text. The real fixtures and explicit arithmetic expose omitted offsets or reversed composition; no exact evaluator coordinates required.
controls.limit: Arithmetic/source checks are not executed viewer alignment. Valid normalization with original metadata/warnings is separate from claiming translation-first is conforming.

controls.title: Associated label discovery and registration
controls.frozen_full_criterion: Resolve declared association and level/coordinate relationship before overlaying; do not attach by folder basename or array dimensions alone. Unsupported geometry stays explicit.

participant_evidence.match: Equal level counts do not guarantee

controls.reason: Full: declared relative labels/source association, metadata-owning entry, level count and actual transforms must be resolved before overlays. Equal shapes/counts and filename suffixes are explicitly insufficient. Nested/source-ambiguous/optional-metadata and mismatched-level specimens supply discriminating checks with explicit conformance or unsupported outcomes.
controls.limit: J7 older challenge mismatch is a different URL from J5/J6 newer matching-level specimen; not contradictory data.

controls.title: Categorical label identity
controls.frozen_full_criterion: Preserve categorical identity through decoding/lookup/resampling, or declare an exact supported range and refuse unsupported data. Do not turn palette preference into a format mandate.
controls.reason: Half: signed/large integer identity, avoiding float loss, sparse-ID allocation, display separation and nearest-neighbor behavior are explicit, with palette recommendations not mandates. However, lookup by label-value rather than color/property entry position is not explicitly preserved anywhere in final participant prose, nor an equivalent scrambled/sparse metadata-lookup check or exact restricted support contract. Do not infer it from retained primary source bytes.
controls.limit: This submechanism was explicit in discovery leads. Its omission does not erase improved precision/resampling treatment; no positional-lookup defect is claimed in unimplemented code.

controls.title: Metadata-driven chunk decoding
controls.frozen_full_criterion: Identify pipeline/layout/endian correctness and require an explicit support boundary or evidence for the chosen reader; unsupported data must not be displayed as decoded pixels.

participant_evidence.match: Concrete drift matters even with identical codec names

controls.reason: Half: actual transpose/sharding permutation behavior and post-pin fix show far more than a codec list; unsupported chains and metadata-versus-decoded success are qualified. Yet the final prose does not state reverse-order decoding and does not supply an endian-discriminating decoding/layout acceptance check or equivalent complete admitted-byte pipeline boundary. Little-endian sample metadata plus big-endian compatibility mentions do not close that mechanism.
controls.limit: No exact private tile required; an equivalent source-backed check would suffice. The inspected upstream permutation test was not executed by participant/evaluator.

controls.title: Absent data versus failed reads
controls.frozen_full_criterion: Distinguish valid absent/fill data from read/decode/cancellation failures; show the actual state and never repair/write source data to fabricate successful viewing.

participant_evidence.match: A failed/partial destination must not be presented

controls.reason: Full: declared fill is separated from I/O/decode errors, missing arrays, viewer placeholders and incomplete/cancelled destinations. Truthful state and stale-selection handling are explicit. The concrete source-directory CSV write trap and derived-cache placement close the read-only boundary rather than relying on a generic assertion. Discriminating bad/missing/corrupt/cancelled checks are proposed.
controls.limit: No nonzero-fill, cancellation-latency or filesystem-immutability runtime test executed; research closure is not runtime repair.
